mathematics.assertion_tested: Localized chiral l2 modes below all scalar vacuum thresholds have nonzero action-derived quadratic l4 second-harmonic sources and positive unit rotating energy with correct intrinsic J.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Complex sparse eigenmodes, explicit polynomial nonlinear Taylor coefficients and analytic Gaunt factor
mathematics.conventions: Profiles relaxed on each same-action variational finite grid; canonical real field A[Z Y22 exp(+iOmega t)+c.c.] with dphiY=-imY and unitK. Source at2Omega is -r sqrt(5/(14pi))*Nquadratic(Z/r).
inputs: Finite-profile operator and declared classical potential
non_claims: No spontaneous source in the absence of mode excitation
No radiated fraction or decay coefficient until outgoing solve
No merger spectrum or galactic orbital angular momentum transfer
No continuum or nonlinear stability theorem
